subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox take ongoing built-in ownership of a `cloud-run-sandbox` provider for Google Cloud Run's public-preview sandbox feature and its gateway-based operating model?
rationale: The patch is a new provider and configuration surface rather than a correction to an established contract; code review cannot determine the repository's desired maintenance and support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor as preview provider
options.body: Accept the built-in provider with its documented preview status and commit to maintaining the gateway, credential, and compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep it external for now
options.body: Pause or close the core addition until maintainers want to own the preview service integration, preserving the implementation as a reference for a future external adapter.

recommendation.title: Sponsor as preview provider
recommendation.body: Accept the built-in provider with its documented preview status and commit to maintaining the gateway, credential, and compatibility surface.

likelyOwner.reason: No concrete current-main provider-area owner could be established from the available history material.
